tutRaidBody: Spend raid charges to crack rivals' vaults and take liquid capital — or post bounties so the city poaches for you. Getting hit grants a REVENGE charge; deed locks shield half your credits.
landQuickRaidBody: rivals' vaults with raid charges — take liquid capital, post bounties on buildings you covet, and answer raids with revenge charges. Deed locks shield your credits.
